question_patterns_en: what does a giant panda eat
cards.answer_zh: 大熊猫以高纤维竹类为主食；本原型只依据已登记科普卡回答。
cards.answer_en: Giant pandas mainly eat high-fibre bamboo; this prototype answers only from registered knowledge cards.

question_patterns_zh: 大熊猫为什么有伪拇指
大熊猫的伪拇指有什么用
question_patterns_en: how do giant pandas grip bamboo
what is a giant panda pseudo-thumb
what is a panda's pseudo-thumb for
cards.answer_zh: 大熊猫前爪的伪拇指与其他趾组成对握结构，便于握竹；这是物种层面的科普，不代表任何个体的当前状态。
cards.answer_en: A giant panda's pseudo-thumb works with its other digits to grip bamboo. This species-level fact does not describe an individual animal's current condition.

question_patterns_zh: 大熊猫为什么花那么长时间进食
大熊猫为什么要大量进食
question_patterns_en: why do pandas spend so much time eating
why do giant pandas eat for so long
why do pandas eat so much bamboo
cards.answer_zh: 大熊猫对竹类的消化利用率较低，通过大量进食获取所需能量，因此花较多时间进食；不能据此判断某只熊猫是否健康。
cards.answer_en: Giant pandas digest bamboo inefficiently and eat large amounts to obtain enough energy, so feeding takes considerable time. This does not establish an individual panda's health.
